name: progress-channel
description: One visible channel for every long-running process — local sweeps, backgrounded commands, and work handed to external systems. The server that serves the live progress page IS the tracker: a tiny stdlib Python daemon holds live jobs in memory (auto-spawned by the first producer, single writer, no store locking), persists only the duration history to an append-only JSONL, and derives liveness — orphans by checking producer pids directly, stalls from each job's own learned cadence — with learned ETAs and pre-start forecasts.
